|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Lieutenant Cecius (V)]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB6-12-Lieutenant_Cecius-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Lieutenant Cecius (V)]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Lieutenant Cecius (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Lieutenant Cecius (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Lieutenant Cecius (V)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Opponent's characters are deploy +1 to same mobile site. At battlegrounds where you have a unique (•) and non-unique Imperial present (and no other Force drain bonus), your Force drains are +1. Tactical Support is a Used Interrupt.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Lieutenant Cecius (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “12” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “no other Force drain bonus” to “no other bonus to your Force drain”: “Opponent's characters are deploy +1 to same mobile site. At battlegrounds where you have a unique (•) and non-unique Imperial present (and no other bonus to your Force drain), your Force drains are +1. Tactical Support is a Used Interrupt.”.<ref name="cl-1261_16-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Lieutenant Cecius (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-lieutenantcecius-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Lieutenant Cecius (V)]]) again, word for word: “Opponent's characters are deploy +1 to same mobile site. At battlegrounds where you have a unique (•) and non-unique Imperial present (and no other Force drain bonus), your Force drains are +1. Tactical Support is a Used Interrupt.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “12” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Lieutenant Cecius (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 11)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Lieutenant Cecius (V)]]) again, word for word: “Opponent's characters are deploy +1 to same mobile site. At battlegrounds where you have a unique (•) and non-unique Imperial present (and no other Force drain bonus), your Force drains are +1. Tactical Support is a Used Interrupt.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-16-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “12”).
